* **Records stay records**: a line break in any value now becomes a
  space, so a date, amount, reference or category can no longer end a
  record early or forge one, and a huge amount no longer exhausts
  memory.
* **Tested on Linux, macOS and Windows, and fuzzed**: CI runs CPython
  3.10 to 3.14 on all three, and an Atheris target fuzzes `to_qif` on
  every change (it found the line-break bug).
* **Signed releases with provenance**: each GitHub release now carries
  cosign signatures, a SLSA provenance file and SBOMs, and every CI
  action and install is pinned by hash.
* **Built against core 0.0.35, with a user manual**: requires
  `bankstatementparser >= 0.0.35`, and an MkDocs manual with the full
  field mapping is deployed to GitHub Pages.
